def sparse(h,w,bg,pts):
 g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
 for r,c,v in pts:g[r][c]=v
 return g
# create expected through specs: original + explicit line cells
examples=[]
def addex(inp, exp): examples.append((inp,exp))
# demo 1
inp=sparse(9,9,4,[(2,1,1),(7,6,1)]); exp=[row[:] for row in inp]
for i in range(6):exp[2+i][1+i]=1
addex(inp,exp)
# demo 2
inp=sparse(8,11,8,[(1,6,1),(6,1,1),(3,4,6)]); exp=[row[:] for row in inp]
for i in range(6): exp[1+i][6-i]=1
for r in range(8):
 c=1+r
 if c<11:exp[r][c]=6
addex(inp,exp)
# demo 3
inp=sparse(9,12,4,[(1,7,1),(7,1,1),(6,7,6)]); exp=[row[:] for row in inp]
for i in range(7):exp[1+i][7-i]=1
addex(inp,exp)
# demo4
inp=sparse(15,12,5,[(3,1,1),(9,7,1),(2,9,6),(5,3,6),(8,6,6),(13,4,6)]); exp=[row[:] for row in inp]
for i in range(7):exp[3+i][1+i]=1
for r in range(15):
 c=8-r+5 # anti through (5,3): sum 8
 if 0<=c<12: exp[r][c]=6
 c=14-r # anti through (8,6): sum14
 if 0<=c<12: exp[r][c]=6
addex(inp,exp)
# demo5
inp=sparse(15,16,8,[(2,2,1),(3,12,1),(11,11,1),(14,3,1),(1,8,6),(9,9,6),(10,1,6),(14,13,6)]); exp=[row[:] for row in inp]
for i in range(10):exp[2+i][2+i]=1
for r in range(15):
 c=18-r
 if 0<=c<16:exp[r][c]=6
addex(inp,exp)
